column2: [title24][sentence]\nIt appears to be another hut.  In fact\nthere are a few of them up there.
[title24][sentence]\nWow!  There's another woman up there!\n
[title20][sentence]\nThe grass here is unusually tall.
[title24][sentence]\nThe rocks here are of little interest.

[title21][sentence]
Inside this cave is the small pool you from
which you emerged after escaping from
your ship.

[title29][sentence]
It's wonderful to see sky again after spending
so much time under water.  The clear blue
sky appears to be free of hostile spacecraft.
[title24][sentence]\nThe field to the north looks quite large.
[title22][sentence]\nThe trees in the distance appear to mark the\nedge of a thick forest.
[title20][sentence]\nThese odd-looking alien plants do not hold\nyour interest for long.
[title17][sentence]\nThe tall majestic mountains remind you\nof something you haven't seen in a while.

[title20][sentence]
You are standing at the southern end of
a large field.
[title30][sentence]\nYou feel much better after your self-administered\nRorschach determines that it's all your parents' fault..
[title27][sentence]\nYou think you see a small grass hut to the west.\nYou think a lot of things, but this one is almost a sure thing.
[title22][sentence]\nThis bush looks like it may have had leaves at\none time.
[title27][sentence]\nA little proverb: Once a rock, always a rock.
[title18][sentence]\nThe small cactus looks pretty nasty.  You decide\nto leave it alone.
[title22][sentence]\nIn order to do that, you would have to\ntouch it.  Not a good idea.
[title24][sentence]\nYour eyes and mouth water at the sight \nof a tree bearing luscious melons.
[title24][sentence]\nThis pit looks truly deep.  You decide to\nbe careful walking around it.
[title29][sentence]\nThese must have fallen from that thorny bush.
[title29][sentence]\nIt looks like someone was trying to set a trap.\nOf course it won't work because there's no bait.
[title22][sentence]\nThe pit is well hidden by the leaves.

[title33][sentence]
You put the [noun1] carefully on the leaves.
OOPS!  It was too heavy and fell down to the
bottom of the pit.  Well, so much for the [noun1].
[title28][sentence]\nYou are not interested in any of these trees.
[title22][sentence]\nTrying to pick those leaves up would be dangerous.\nYou might fall in.

[title20][sentence]
Good work.  You bagged the large hungry one.
She won't be climbing out of that pit any time
soon.

[title24][sentence]
After all the trouble you went through trapping
her you want to pull her out?!  Do you think
she's particularly pleased with you right now?
You had better leave her where she is.

[title32][sentence]
You are standing at the center of a wide field
which stretches off in all directions.  To the
west, you see a small village in the distance.
There is a deep pit here, next to the thorny bush.

[title32][sentence]
You are standing at the center of a wide field
which stretches off in all directions.  To the
west, you see a small village in the distance.
There is a deep pit here, which has been hidden
under a pile of carefully placed leaves.

[title32][sentence]
You are standing at the center of a wide field
which stretches off in all directions.  To the
west, you see a small village in the distance.
An enormous man-eating woman is stuck in a pit
here; her legs flail piteously in the air.  Perhaps
you'd better get about your business quickly, because
she's not going to be happy when she finally gets
out of that pit.
[title32][sentence]\nAre you mad?  If you pull her out of that\npit, she'll eat you for breakfast!
[title26][sentence]\nThe only thing you have even a prayer\nof understanding is the keypad in the center.

[title33][sentence]
The digits 0 through 9 accompany
a 'smile' key and a 'frown' key.
Printed foam number pads
provide comfort when pressed.
There is a 4-digit number written
on the panel above the display.
[title17][sentence]\nThis display obviously shows you\nwhat you have typed.
[title20][sentence]\nThe island has not changed since\nyou stepped into this device.

[title28][sentence]
It's a cylindrical object containing
some alien electronics, a keypad, and
a shipwrecked space adventurer.
[title27][sentence]\nIt is a little key with a symbol printed on it.\n
[title21][sentence]\nA brief look back from whence you came\nyields no great inspiration.

[title24][sentence]
This plant bears a round wooden stem with a
soft core used for building huts, tools, weapons,
and limbo poles.
[title19][sentence]\nPretty.  Steep.  Insurmountable.
[title16][sentence]\nThe grass here has been stained with the\nremains of many broken melons.
[title18][sentence]\nThe field lying directly to the\nwest is flat and desolate.
[title22][sentence]\nA few large rocks appear to occupy the\narea to the north of you.

[title26][sentence]
It appears to be a wooden stalk that fell
from the nearby patch.  It has probably
been there for a while, since the core has 
rotted out.
[title20][sentence]\nIf the monkey were hungry, he would probably\njust eat some of the melons growing in that tree.

[title26][sentence]
Wow!  Those darts really work.  That little bugger's
head shrunk down to walnut-size in seconds.  Of course
you had to use all of them to hit him.
[title26][sentence]\nYou proudly recover your stolen binoculars.
[title21][sentence]\nA large melon tree sits in a grassy clearing\nbetween a mountain and a patch of bamboo-like trees.
[title24][sentence]\nThe trees are tall, green, and beautiful.
[title17][sentence]\nThat's the little bugger who stole \nyour binoculars!
[title19][sentence]\nThat won't accomplish anything.

[title24][sentence]
You're going to have to find a better
way to propel them than that.  These aren't
throwing darts, they're blowgun darts.
[title21][sentence]\nAlthough it resembles a palm, this tree bears\nlarge red fruits instead of coconuts.

[title22][sentence]
Although it resembles a palm, this tree bears
large red fruits instead of coconuts.  Currently
there is a kleptomaniac monkey dancing about
up there.
[title26][sentence]\nThis is the tree from which that obnoxious monkey\nwas teasing you.  He sure learned his lesson.

[title24][sentence]
The remains of several dozen melons have left
a large stain on the grass.  They appear too spread
out to have fallen from the tree.

[title21][sentence]
You briefly consider scooping up a handful
of melon goo.  You then consider doing
something else.

[title30][sentence]
You are overwhelmed by night fever.  You
get the urge to whip off your coat and start
swinging it around your head.  Fortunately,
sanity prevails and you decide not to draw
attention to yourself.

[title27][sentence]
You sense that something is wrong
with this teleporter.  You decide to
let someone else test it for you.

[title32][sentence]
The last person you saw come out of
this teleporter didn't look too healthy.
You decide not to experiment with
temperamental teleporters. (Say THAT
10 times fast!)

[title30][sentence]
This bar looks just like any of a hundred other
bars you've seen on as many planets.
There is a flat surface for holding drinks
and a soft pad on which you could comfortably
pass out.  You make a quick mental note
that the bartender could probably
beat you in an arm-wrestling match.

[title22][sentence]
Yech!  Is she ugly.  A face like that could
stop a windmill on an old Dutch painting.
She spends a great deal of time polishing the
bar and pouring shots for that tired-looking
woman on the first stool.

[title22][sentence]
You marvel at the length of the ash hanging
off of her cigarette.  She blows an occasional
smoke ring your way, but looks like she wants
to be left alone.

[title29][sentence]
She appears to be enjoying herself, watching
everyone else in the bar.  She refuses to meet
your gaze, but instead seems focused on the
bartender.
[title25][sentence]\nShe is obviously waiting for someone\nelse.

[title18][sentence]
You could rate this woman a '10', but only
on the Richter scale.    The telltale fault line
on her backside indicates a maintenance
position.  The tool belt is also a good tip.
[title20][sentence]\nThis leads back into the corridor.

[title21][sentence]
You notice some women, a dance floor,
some more women, a bar, a mirror ball,
women, some plants, and some women.
You were beginning to wonder what these
women did for recreation.  You decide to
move cautiously and not draw too much
attention to yourself.

[title22][sentence]
The women up there seem content in
each other's company.  It would be rude
to interrupt them.

[title25][sentence]
Have you ever been body-slammed before?
Well, keep it up and you should have no 
trouble whatsoever having that beautiful 
figure of yours flattened.

[title27][sentence]
They are busy talking to each other.  If
you interview everyone in the bar you
may draw undue attention to yourself.

[title26][sentence]
Considering her distance from you, and
the ambient sound level in this room, the
odds of her hearing you are slim.  Very slim.
You decide that yelling at her would be
unwise.
[title21][sentence]\nThe railing appears to be serving it's purpose.\nNo one is falling from the balcony.
[title22][sentence]\nThe tables are round, flat, and have\nfour legs.  What did you expect?

[title30][sentence]
You have no need for a new table.
Especially when you consider the
fact that you no longer have a home to
put it in.

[title21][sentence]
The sign proudly displays the name of this
establishment.  It seems to require some
maintenance, as the last letter can't decide
if it should remain lit or not.

[title30][sentence]
What would you DO with an eight-foot
blinking neon sign?  You need to have
your head examined.

[title26][sentence]
There are three stools in front of the bar.
One is occupied by a large woman wearing
a tool belt.  The other two look padded
and comfortable.

[title25][sentence]
Not only are they bolted to the floor, but
you would look rather silly walking around
with a bar stool.
[title21][sentence]\nThe cactus is just another part of this\nwonderfully decorated bar.

[title21][sentence]
After pondering for a moment the
implications of stuffing a cactus in
your pocket, you decide to leave it
where it is.

[title24][sentence]
The rotating mirror ball is the icon
of the trashy discotheque.  You feel right
at home under it's familiar light.

[title26][sentence]
The upper dance floor is just large
enough to hold one or two people.
At the moment, there is only one
person up there, and she is not dancing.
[title19][sentence]\nThe trees around the bar add to the decor.\nThey go well with the native rock walls.
[title25][sentence]\nThere are several plants hanging beneath the\nbalcony.  They look well cared for.
[title21][sentence]\nAre we getting a little desperate?

[title16][sentence]
The tip of a folded piece of paper
protrudes from the woman's back
pocket.

[title29][sentence]
You carefully extract the list from
the woman's pocket.  Fortunately,
she is well anesthetized, and
doesn't notice your thievery.

[title32]ALIEN LIQUOR
Having paid for the bottle of liquor,
you now stash it in your jacket for
safekeeping.
[title32]CREDIT CHIP\nYou retrieve your credit chip from the bar, hoping\nto find further use for it later.

[title29][sentence]
You are standing on what must surely be a
maintenance platform above the city.  A
breathtaking view of the city stretches before
you, revealing the bizarre two level structure
in it's entirety.  Apparently, the entire
metropolis was constructed inside an enormous,
inactive volcano cone.  Far below, you see the
glowing magma which warms the city.  Behind
you and beyond the rim of the city, you can see
only ocean.  You pause for a moment in awe of
this engineering marvel, after which you notice
that you are standing almost directly over a large
statue of a beautiful woman.

[title25][sentence]
This is obviously the end of the line
for the elevator.  The doors have
closed, but since you haven't heard
any movement. You assume that it is
waiting for you.

[title27][sentence]
The rim of the city is obviously the top
of the volcano cone.  The short section
you are standing on has been paved, and
you imagine that it must be a maintenance
platform.

[title27][sentence]
These probably served some purpose
during construction of the city.  Time and
weather have taken their toll on these
outcroppings, in some cases revealing
the reinforcing steel beneath.

[title21][sentence]
A sharp metal hook protrudes from the
right-most pylon.  The weather has
rusted most of the metal away.

[title20][sentence]
You fishing line dangles from the small
metal hook.  It extends to the base
of a large statue below.

[title25][sentence]
A cone of igneous rock surrounds the rim
of the city.  The sunlight washes warmly over
it's pocked blue-purple surface.
[title16][sentence]\nYou don't need any pumice.
[title20][sentence]\nTo the east you see a teleporter\nbooth.

[title27][sentence]
You skillfully tie the fishing line to the metal
hook, then toss the fishing line toward the
large statue below.
[title21][sentence]\nAnd undo all your wonderful work?

[title20][sentence]
This tall building towers over all the
other buildings.  It looks like the tallest
building in the entire city.

[title32][sentence]
If you tie the line to a pylon, it is likely
to slip off over the top.  There is, however,
a sharp hook-like protrusion on the upper right
corner of the right-most pylon.  You could probably
tie the line securely to that.

[title25][sentence]
On the desk you see a pair of monitors,
some papers, a coffee mug, and the stale
remains of a doughnut.

[title25][sentence]
The rear wall is carved out of rock, much
like the cell you just escaped from.  One
wall is covered with equipment.  Since this
equipment is unfamiliar to you, and you are
trying to remain undetected, you decide
not to play with it.

[title27][sentence]
Apparently the same interior decorator
who chose 'early Mesozoic igneous' decor
for the back wall chose 'art deco' for these
lighting fixtures.
[title25][sentence]\nThe panels of white lights keep this room\nextremely well lit.
[title21][sentence]\nYou don't have any need for forty feet of\nfluorescent light fixtures.

[title26][sentence]
The little bulb dangling from a wire
in the middle of the room is dwarfed
by the light panels on either side.  This
must have been left here by the original
construction crew.
[title21][sentence]\nAttempting to steal this little light bulb\nwould accomplish little.

[title25][sentence]
Although you don't see anyone, you hear people.
You decide to be VERY quiet.  If you were
discovered, you might have to explain yourself
to that wonderful doctor.
[title25][sentence]\nYou don't see any guards, but you\ndecide to stay put and not take any chances.

[title25][sentence]
In this extremely well-lit room you see a
desk with a pair of monitors on it.
After a look about, you conclude that
this must be some sort of monitoring station.

[title19][sentence]
You pretty much destroyed the latch when
you kicked the grate open.  You shouldn't
have any trouble getting it open again.

[title25][sentence]
A message engraved on the statue's
hand reads: "You must be at least this 
high to enter the teleporter."
[title16][sentence]\nYou would look pretty silly carrying this\nthing around with you.

[title26][sentence]
This must be the baggage belt.  You have
been wary of these things ever since your
favorite suitcase was eaten by a Rectarian
baggage handler.

[title25][sentence]
That is not a good idea.  It's a safe bet
that anything that goes on that belt
ends up in a black hole somewhere.

[title24][sentence]
You have become familiar with devices of
this type.  There is a small note on it which
reads: "Attention transmorphs:  This machine's
gender security system is still active!"

[title22][sentence]
The display show all sorts of status
information about teleporters.  From the
number of lines on the display you gather
there must be many such teleporters.
Too bad they don't list the teleport codes here.
[title24][sentence]\nThis leads to a long east-west corridor.

[title32][sentence]
The pictures show various exquisite
vacation spots.  Can't you just see yourself 
lying on the beach with a Tikillya Earthrise, 
looking for shells.  You decide to stop
daydreaming and do something productive.
[title17][sentence]\nThe plants need water, but otherwise\nthey look all right.

[title30][sentence]
You are overwhelmed by a sudden urge
to gather flowers and place them in
strategically aesthetic spots around the room.
The urge leaves you hoping the gender
bender still works in reverse.

[title18][sentence]
In this tiny room you see a teleporter,
a strange display on the wall, and a
conveyer belt.  One wall is littered
with pictures.

[title32]BLUB BLUB BLUB
As the elevator descends into the flooded
city, you have a bad feeling.  When the
elevator doors open, you have an even worse
feeling.

[title32]BLUB BLUB BLUB
It looks like that time bomb has just
pulled the plug on your wretched little
life.

[title22][sentence]
This is a video monitor.  You surmise that
the buttons on the bottom of it select various
camera views.
[title17][sentence]\nThis is a text monitor.  It is probably\ntied to a computer somewhere.
[title18][sentence]\nThe desk is cluttered with loads of\nunimportant objects.
